response.sql: WITH circuit_counts AS (SELECT circuitId, COUNT(*) AS race_count FROM races GROUP BY circuitId), shares AS (SELECT circuitId, race_count, 1.0 * race_count / SUM(race_count) OVER () AS share FROM circuit_counts), excesses AS (SELECT circuitId, race_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS excess_share FROM shares), ranked AS (SELECT *, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY excess_share DESC) AS rank_by_excess FROM excesses WHERE excess_share > 0) SELECT circuitId, race_count, share, excess_share FROM ranked WHERE rank_by_excess <= 10 ORDER BY excess_share DESC, circuitId;
